documented_file_layout: 256 shards `stage4c_sentdedup/00000.jsonl`–`00255.jsonl` (+ README.md), 937,404,753,041 bytes = 937.4 GB total (stats json). USE all 256. Shards are MOSTLY but NOT fully homogeneous by upstream corpus. First-record classification gives HPLT 180 shards (716.8 GB, 76.5% of bytes), CulturaX 49 (153.7 GB, 16.4%), FineWeb-2 27 (67.0 GB, 7.1%) — but a 60,087-window probe of every shard (64 KB windows at 16 MB stride, plus 2 MB stride over each shard's last 32 MB; 3.94 GB read = 0.420% of the corpus) finds FineWeb-2 records in 31 shards, in four contiguous runs 00057–00067, 00192–00200, 00215–00220, 00251–00255 (78.0 GB of shard bytes), i.e. at least 5 shards straddle a corpus boundary: 00057 (3.41 GB, labelled HPLT, ~92% FineWeb-2), 00116 (3.37 GB, labelled CulturaX, last ~30% HPLT), 00192, 00215, 00251. **A FOURTH sub-corpus hides in the tail of the LAST shard**: `metadata.name == 'fineweb-2-grc'`, polytonic ANCIENT Greek, occupying `00255.jsonl` from byte 1,340,068,163 to EOF — the final 119,266,344 bytes, 8.17% of that shard and 0.0127% of the unit, 13,452 records, perfectly contiguous (I parsed every record of 00255 from byte 1.30 GB on: 15,186 `fineweb-2-ell`, then 13,452 `fineweb-2-grc`, zero ell records after the first grc). It exists in NO other shard: `LC_ALL=C grep -ac 'fineweb-2-grc'` over all 31 FineWeb-2-bearing shards read in full (78.0 GB = 8.3% of the corpus) returns 13,452 for 00255 and 0 for the other 30, and the 0.42% whole-corpus probe hits it nowhere else. **Classify per record** from `metadata` (the 4-predicate set in cleaning step 1), never by shard: by shard the CulturaX/FineWeb-2-specific cleaning mis-routes ~14 GB, and the grc tail — which needs the ancient, not the modern-web, path — is invisible. CulturaX shards mix mC4 (~77%) and OSCAR-2019/2109/2201/2301 (~23%). No metadata-only or manifest files.

schema_documentation:
3 top-level keys, 100% presence, identical across all shards (stats json `toplevel_key_sets`: single set for all 16,902 sampled records).

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | str | 100% | HPLT = 32-hex; CulturaX = `CulturaX/train.jsonl/<n>`; FineWeb-2 = `<urn:uuid:…>` |
| `text` | str | 100% | plain-text document — THE training field |
| `metadata` | dict | 100% | provenance; sub-keys depend on upstream corpus, and are the ONLY reliable router |

**metadata (HPLT variant, 45.7% of sampled records)** — `u` str 100% (URL, mean 100.6 ch), `f` str (WARC path), `o`/`s`/`rs` int (offset/size), `c` str enum {text/html, application/xml, application/atom+xml}, `ts` str (ISO ts), `de` str enum {utf-8, windows-1253, iso-8859-7, ascii}, `crawl_id` str enum (28 CC-MAIN dumps + wide5/6/10/12/15/16, survey3), `lang` list[str] len 3 (NLLB codes, `ell_Grek` first), `prob` list[num] len 3, `seg_langs` list[str] (per-segment LID, mean 20.3 entries, max 1028), `doc_scores` list[num] len 10, `html_lang` list[str] len 1 (31.4%), `cluster_size` int, `filter` str = always `"keep"`, `pii` list of `[start,end]` int pairs, `web-register` dict of 25 float probabilities (NA/IN/OP/IP/ID/HI/LY/SP/MT + 16 lowercase sub-registers), `xml` str (99.9% of HPLT records — 1,499/1,500 in my 48-shard sample; = 45.65% of ALL records; mean 3,674.9 ch, max 512,133), `file_path` str.

**metadata (FineWeb-2 variant, 14.0% of records) — ONE 14-key set shared by BOTH language subsets** — `name` ∈ {`fineweb-2-ell`, `fineweb-2-grc`}, `dataset`=`HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-2`, `dump`, `date`, `url`, `file_path`, `shard_id`, `language` ∈ {`ell`, `grc`}, `language_score` float, `language_script`=`Grek`, `top_langs` str = literal `"{}"` (dead field), `minhash_cluster_size` int, `token_count` int, `word_count` int. `name`/`language` are the ONLY discriminators between the modern and the ancient subset — `dump` is on both (390 dump-bearing records in my 48-shard sample = 384 ell + 6 grc), so `has:dump` CANNOT select the modern one. The grc subset, measured over all 13,452 of its records: `language`='grc' 100%, `language_score` min 0.814 / p50 0.975 / max 1.000, 96 distinct CC dumps (CC-MAIN-2013-20 … CC-MAIN-2023-40), 546 distinct URL hosts, `token_count` sum 42,019,280 and `word_count` sum 11,196,147 (upstream counts; my own whitespace count is 9,590,114).

**metadata (CulturaX variant, 40.3% via `source`)** — only `source` (enum mC4/OSCAR-2019/2109/2201/2301), `url`, `timestamp` (str, 6.2% empty), `file_path`. No quality scores.
semantic_meaning: Sentence-deduplicated merge of three Greek web corpora (HPLT v2, CulturaX=mC4+OSCAR, FineWeb-2-ell) PLUS a fourth, tiny sub-corpus — a contiguous 119.3 MB / 13,452-record polytonic ANCIENT Greek tail (`fineweb-2-grc`) at the end of shard 00255; the collection's largest source.
